producer.name: claude normalization
producer.ingestedFrom: status activity kind delegating for child tasks

transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Child status rows emit monitor status activityKind delegating. active is false when a hook has stopped that agent id, when status is idle, or when status is in cancelled, completed, done, failed, stopped. Otherwise active is true, including when status is missing.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: The activity line is label, else description, else status, else name, else type, else the literal Subagent active.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: Root status is not a monitor status upsert. Hook pipeline emits turn, tool, permission, and question events. Those are a separate channel.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: field.activity.since is not set on the child monitor activity. observedAt is the batch timestamp.
